Container.Name: tv-calibration
Container.Overview:
Automated TV display calibration server with guided workflow, LLM-powered analysis, and ZRO CSV auto-import.
**Setup on Unraid:** 1. Set your ZRO measurement share path in the "ZRO Drops Share" field (e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/zro-drops) 2. Expose that same host path as an Unraid SMB share (User Shares → Add Share) so ColourSpace ZRO on Windows can export directly into it — the container itself does not run Samba, it relies on the host's SMB server 3. Configure LiteLLM endpoint and model in the AI Assistant section of the app UI 4. Open http://<UNRAID_IP>:8000 in your browser
**Services included:** - calcore-server (FastAPI) on port 8000
**Optional:** - Set "OpenRouter API Key" in the template fields for cloud LLM routing - Configure the "LiteLLM Endpoint" and "LiteLLM Model" to point to your LLM proxy - For Dogegen HDR10 pattern generation, set "Dogegen Agent URL" to a Dogegen Companion Agent (tools/dogegen-agent) running on a separate Windows PC — Unraid is a Linux host and cannot run Dogegen.exe itself

Config.Name: App port
Config.Description: Port for the FastAPI web UI

Config.Name: ZRO Drops Share
Config.Description: Host path for ZRO CSV auto-import. Map your ColourSpace export folder here, then expose this same host path as an Unraid SMB share so ColourSpace ZRO on Windows can write to it directly.

Config.Name: Prefs dir
Config.Description: Directory holding the persisted preferences file (.prefs.json lives inside it). Maps to /mnt/user/appdata/tv-calibration/.prefs. Mapping the directory rather than the file itself avoids a Docker bind-mount gotcha where mounting a single host file that doesn't exist yet gets created as a directory instead.

Config.Name: Dogegen Agent URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL of a Dogegen Companion Agent (tools/dogegen-agent) running on a separate Windows PC, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:7071. Unraid is a Linux host, so Dogegen.exe cannot be bind-mounted or run in this container — it must run on a Windows PC and be controlled over the network. If you reach that PC over Tailscale, use its Tailscale IP (100.x.y.z) here rather than the .ts.net MagicDNS name — this container's bridge network can't resolve MagicDNS hostnames unless you also add --dns=100.100.100.100 to Extra Parameters. Leave empty if you aren't using Dogegen.

Config.Name: LiteLLM Endpoint
Config.Description: LiteLLM proxy URL for AI-assisted analysis. Set this if you run a local LiteLLM proxy on Unraid or elsewhere.

Config.Name: LiteLLM Model
Config.Description: Model name to use via the LiteLLM proxy (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, or a local model alias).

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: Optional: OpenRouter API key for cloud LLM routing. Overrides LiteLLM if set.
